reviews.body:
This rename from `.md` to `.mdsp` breaks the documentation:

1. `docs/docs/using/.pages` references `multi-auth-headers.md` — the renamed file won't be found
2. `query-param-auth.md`, `rest-passthrough.md`, and the file itself all link to `multi-auth-headers.md` — all links break
3. `.mdsp` is not a recognized file extension — mkdocs won't process it

What was the intent here? If you meant to disable/hide the page temporarily, there are better approaches (add to mkdocs excludes, or prefix with `_`).
